title: Sangili Bungili Kadhava Thorae
desc: Vasu, a young broker, purchases a bungalow for his family in the outskirts of town. However, they soon start to feel the presence of supernatural forces in the building.

title: Pushpa: The Rise - Part 1
desc: As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.

title: Pechi
desc: Accompanied by a guide, five friends go on a trekking trip to a haunted forest and despite being warned, they enter a restricted area that harbours an evil spirit.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Dj
desc: An undercover officer is tasked with taking down a real estate crime lord and a corrupt politician. However, he faces many obstacles in his mission and tries to overcome them all.

title: Pugaippadam
desc: A group of college friends face love, loss and guilt when one commits suicide over unrequited feelings, testing the bonds of their friendship and loyalty.

title: Ayyanar
desc: Prabha, an idler, is always compared to his younger brother due to his careless attitude. However, when his brother gets killed, he joins a criminal gang to find the people who murdered him.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Unnaiththane
desc: A Christian Zumba instructor and a Hindu upper-caste woman bond over dance and fall in love. But their relationship faces struggles as they face discrimination due to their caste.

title: Vishwaroopam 2
desc: Wisam Ahmad Kashmiri, a RAW agent, tries to prevent a terrorist organisation from executing a deadly mission against three countries.

title: Kalyana Vaibhogam
desc: A man with strong traditional values falls in love with a woman, and they decide to get married, until the groom and the bride's father have a difference of opinion about marriage.

title: Velainu Vandhutta Vellaikaaran
desc: A minister on his deathbed reveals to an MLA the whereabouts of billions in cash that he has stashed away. However, the minister's relatives are vexed when the MLA loses his memory in an accident.

title: Nani's Gang Leader
desc: Five grief-stricken women team up with 'Pencil', a crime novelist, to avenge the death of a man with whom they share a familial relation.

title: Raatchasi
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

title: Ivan Veramathiri
desc: Guna kidnaps Eeswaran, brother of a minister, for orchestrating violence among students. However, Eeswaran escapes and trails after Guna to exact his revenge.
